caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The chair features a natural wood color with slightly darker brown tones in the grain, and it has three horizontal, unevenly curved slats forming the backrest, vertical legs, and armrests that extend outward in a rounded, simple design. The seat of the chair is made from woven material in light brown and greenish-yellow hues, with visible texture and some irregularities along the edge. The wood structure includes horizontal support bars cross-bracing the legs near the ground and just beneath the seat, supporting the chair’s frame. The drawing is detailed, showing individual wood grains and the coarse weaving of the seat. There is a small, handwritten label with the text “SEE CATALOGUE NO.” in tiny letters below the chair. The rest of the background evenly remains an unbroken off-white color, focusing attention solely on the chair.
title: Armchair
